root_causes.description: The frontend container was forcibly terminated ('Killing: Stopping container frontend') and immediately replaced by a freshly scheduled pod frontend-76cbddfbcc-zm8l8, causing the frontend server request rate to collapse mid-window (p50 ~8 req/s vs. a window mean of ~148 req/s). Error rate, CPU and memory stayed normal, indicating a container-level crash/restart rather than a resource or downstream dependency fault.

evidence.observed_value: request_rate: mean=148.190, p50=8.009, p95=432.873, p99=570.433, max=604.823 — sustained collapse mid-window
evidence.expected_baseline: steady ~148 req/s (window mean request_rate for a healthy frontend)

evidence.observed_value: count=1 container termination event in namespace otel-demo
evidence.expected_baseline: no 'Killing' events for a healthy frontend container

evidence.query_or_id: Scheduled: Successfully assigned otel-demo/frontend-76cbddfbcc-zm8l8 to otel-sre-copilot-control-plane
evidence.expected_baseline: no new frontend pod scheduling/creation events in a stable window
no CPU saturation; rules out cpu_stress
no memory growth/OOM pressure; rules out memory_stress
error_rate < 0.01; no error spike, rules out http_abort/dependency_failure

evidence.observed_value: mean=0.000, max=0.000 (restart counter flat in sampled window)
evidence.expected_baseline: 0 restarts for a stable frontend pod

remediation_steps: Confirm the frontend pod restart/crash: kubectl -n otel-demo get pods -l app=frontend and kubectl describe pod frontend-76cbddfbcc-zm8l8 (inspect Last State, Reason, Exit Code).
Inspect the terminated frontend container's previous logs (kubectl logs <prior-frontend-pod> --previous) to distinguish OOMKill, liveness-probe kill, or application crash.
Review frontend liveness/readiness probe configuration and recent frontend deployment changes; if the crash is probe-induced, tune probe thresholds/timeouts to prevent spurious restarts.
Add alerting on frontend request-rate collapse / container 'Killing' events so container-level crashes are detected quickly before user impact widens.
